title: A Phase III study to assess the effect of FDC laroprovstat/rosuvastatin compared with laroprovstat, rosuvastatin and placebo on LDL-C in LLT-naïve patients.
official: A Phase III Randomised, Double-Blind, Factorial Design Study to Assess the Effect of Fixed Dose Combination Laroprovstat/Rosuvastatin compared with Laroprovstat, Rosuvastatin, and Placebo on Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol in Lipid-Lowering Treatment-Naïve Patients
summary:
Main objective: 1. To compare the effect of treatment with FDC laroprovstat/rosuvastatin 2 versus the following on LDL-C at 8 weeks:
• Placebo
• Rosuvastatin 2
• Laroprovstat

2. To compare the effect of treatment with FDC laroprovstat/rosuvastatin 1 versus the following on LDL-C at 8 weeks:
• Placebo
• Rosuvastatin 1
• Laroprovstat
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participant must be ≥ 18 years of age
2. Participants with no clinical history of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) and a 10-year ASCVD risk estimated as low
3. Participants who have not received any LLT in the 3 months prior to screening
Exclusion criteria:
1. Asian origin.
2. Statin intolerance
3. Uncontrolled severe hypertension
4. Uncontrolled type 2 diabetes mellitus
5. Inadequately treated hypothyroidism
